Welcome to My Blog: AI, Research, and the Journey Ahead

December 01, 2024 by Adam Oentoro in General

Welcome to my blog! As I recently completed my Master’s in Artificial Intelligence at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, I’m excited to share my journey, insights, and learnings in the fascinating world of AI and machine learning.

What to Expect

This blog will be a space where I document my experiences and share knowledge about:

Research & Academic Insights

  • Deep dives into my MSc thesis on multi-ontology augmentation for LLM-based systems
  • Explorations of reinforcement learning applications in robotics
  • Discussions on self-adaptive systems and their potential

Technical Tutorials

  • CUDA programming tips and GPU acceleration techniques
  • PyTorch and TensorFlow implementation guides
  • Practical machine learning solutions and optimizations

Industry Perspectives

  • Bridging the gap between academic research and industry applications
  • Thoughts on the future of AI and its ethical implications
  • Career insights for aspiring AI researchers and engineers

My Background

With an international educational journey spanning Taiwan, Indonesia, the UAE, and the Netherlands, I bring a unique global perspective to AI research. My experience as a Teaching Assistant for courses like Machine Learning and Learning Machines has taught me the importance of clear communication in complex technical topics.

Looking Forward

As I seek new opportunities in AI research and machine learning engineering, this blog will serve as a platform to:

  • Share ongoing projects and research
  • Connect with the AI community
  • Contribute to open discussions about AI advancement

Stay tuned for upcoming posts where I’ll dive deeper into specific topics, starting with a detailed exploration of knowledge-augmented LLMs and their applications in real-world scenarios.

Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn or check out my projects on GitHub.

Let’s explore the frontiers of AI together!
